ticket.subject: VAT rate and a former employee
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

Our last invoice has the wrong VAT rate, can you check it?

Also, a former employee has asked us for a copy of all the personal data about them in your app. How do we handle that? We want to answer within the month.

Best regards,
Nikhil Pemberton
engineering manager, Ottervale Software

label_notes: multi_issue: a data access request is present, and privacy beats every other category (P3 medium). Second issue: wrong VAT rate on an invoice (billing).
